Canada, September 18, 2025 -- CASINOenquirer, a trusted authority on online casino insights and reviews, has joined forces with the Daily Mail to bring Ontario players an exclusive look at the Top 10 Online Casinos in Ontario. With more than 85 fully licensed websites now active across the province, this comprehensive guide highlights the best platforms available for Canadians while equipping readers with tools to enjoy safe, responsible, and rewarding online gaming.

Since Ontario legalized and regulated iGaming in 2022, the province has emerged as a hub for online casinos and sportsbooks. Currently, 87 fully licensed sites provide an expansive variety of options for local players. While licensing ensures a level of safety and fairness by cutting out rogue operators, the challenge remains: how do players choose the right one?
CASINOenquirer’s collaboration with the Daily Mail addresses this by evaluating the top contenders in the province based on brand history, payout rates, customer service, game selection, VIP benefits, and mobile experience.
“Ontario players deserve casinos that prioritize safety, fairness, and player satisfaction. Our Daily Mail feature on the best Ontario online casinos is designed to give readers not just recommendations, but also the knowledge to make informed choices when gambling online,” said a CASINOenquirer spokesperson.
Key Factors That Define the Best Ontario Online Casinos
The CASINOenquirer team carefully reviewed multiple operators to spotlight the most reliable and rewarding experiences available.

Longevity is often a mark of trust. Platforms like 888 Casino and JackpotCity, both with over 25 years of experience, continue to stand out thanks to their commitment to fair play and player satisfaction. Deposits & Withdrawals
Canadian players benefit from banking systems tailored to local needs. Most licensed operators accept Interac, MuchBetter, VISA, MasterCard, and PaysafeCard, with some also enabling cryptocurrency payments.

Modern players expect seamless gameplay on-the-go. Ontario’s top casinos offer optimized mobile browser versions, while brands like 888 Casino provide dedicated iOS and Android apps for smoother access and reduced data usage.

Return-to-Player (RTP) rates are a vital measure of fairness. With top slot games offering RTPs above 95%, Ontario’s licensed operators provide transparency and competitive odds. CASINOenquirer advises players to always check the displayed payout rates before starting a game.
Customer Service & VIP Programs
Smaller operators often shine with personalized customer service, making players feel valued beyond being “just a number.” VIP perks, loyalty programs, and responsive support teams add layers of trust and engagement.
Game Selection
Ontario’s leading casinos host titles from NetEnt, Microgaming, Evolution, Novomatic, and more, ensuring a diverse library of slots, table games, and live dealer experiences. Exclusive slot titles are also available only to Ontario residents at brands like JackpotCity, LeoVegas, and 888.
Benefits of Playing at Licensed Ontario Casinos
By choosing locally regulated operators, players enjoy a wide range of protections and perks:
Safety & Security : Strict oversight from iGaming Ontario (iGO) and the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) guarantees secure play. Dispute Resolution : Players have access to official channels if payout or service issues arise. Exclusive Games : Ontario-only slots and titles enhance the local player experience. Banking Confidence : Regulated sites partner with trusted financial institutions, ensuring fast and reliable transactions. Player Requirements in Ontario
To access Ontario’s online casinos, players must:
Be 19 years or older. Be physically located in Ontario (verified via geotargeting). Provide accurate identification during registration and KYC verification. A Commitment to Responsible Gambling
Licensed Ontario operators are legally bound to provide responsible gambling tools. These include:
Deposit Limits (daily, weekly, monthly). Self-Exclusion Programs for those needing breaks. Reality Checks to monitor gaming time. Dedicated Support Teams trained to identify risky behaviour and step in proactively. This ensures that entertainment remains safe, balanced, and player-focused.
Why Regulated Ontario Casinos Lead the Way
CASINOenquirer emphasizes that regulated iGaming Ontario casinos are the safest and smartest choice for local players. Their standout benefits include:
100% Legal & Secure : Licensed casinos comply with Ontario’s strict regulations. Fair Play Guaranteed : Independent random number generators ensure game fairness. Regulatory Backing : AGCO and iGO mediate disputes and enforce transparency. Accountability : Non-compliance can result in license loss, holding operators to the highest standard.
